title: Values given another way: written as found, with a number in the key's unit only where the text supports it
about: The shelf life is '2 years' (key in months). The temperature is '25 °C ± 2 °C'. The months are 'eighteen (18)'. The batch size has thousands separators. The impurity limit is a decimal. The label gives only 77 °F for a key in C.

fact_keys.description: Limit for any single unspecified degradation product
Storage temperature limit on the label

pages:
Summary of Product Characteristics (draft, sections 1 to 6)

1. Name of the medicinal product

Pelnixa 25 mg film-coated tablets

2. Qualitative and quantitative composition

Each film-coated tablet contains 25 mg of pelnixa.

3. Pharmaceutical form

Film-coated tablet. White, oval, biconvex tablets.

6.3 Shelf life

The shelf life of the medicinal product is 2 years.

6.4 Special precautions for storage

Keep in the original package.

6.5 Nature and contents of container

PVC/PVDC-Alu blisters in cartons of 30 tablets.

Stability report: Pelnixa 25 mg film-coated tablets

This report supports the shelf life requested in Module 1.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

The long-term study was stored at 25 °C ± 2 °C / 60 % ± 5 % RH for eighteen (18) months. The accelerated study was stored at 40 °C ± 2 °C / 75 % ± 5 % RH for six (6) months.

Specification: any single unspecified degradation product: not more than 0.15 %.

3.2.P.3 Manufacture

3.2.P.3.1 Manufacturer(s)

The finished product is manufactured at Larkfield Pharma, Plant 1, 3 Orchard Way, Tennant.

The commercial batch size is 1,200,000 tablets.

3.2.P.3.3 Description of manufacturing process

Direct compression of the blend, followed by tablet compression, film coating and blister packing. In-process controls are listed in section 3.2.P.3.4.

Label excerpt (export presentation)

Pelnixa 25 mg film-coated tablets, 30 tablets.

Store below 77 °F. Keep out of the reach of children.
